//: Overhaul Prompt 10 (docs/gameplay-overhaul/14-resources-and-cooking.md): the galley's ingredients, its cooked food and a tot of grog. Only the opt-in supplies system hands these out (data/ship/supplies.json sources and recipes); no chapter gives or takes them.
name: Beans
description: Dried beans, a sack of them. The galley's answer to everything. Cook them.

name: Onions
description: Ship's onions, sprouting a little. Cook them.

name: Oats
description: A bag of rolled oats, mostly oats. Cook them.

name: Garlic
description: A string of garlic. Strong enough to argue with. Cook it.

name: Salt Fish
description: Salted, dried, flat and firm. Soak it and cook it.

name: Bean Stew
description: Thick and filling. Restores 25 HP; a full belly makes emergency work quicker for a while.

name: Oat Porridge
description: Plain and warm. Restores 15 HP; steady hands widen the green on repair bars for a while.

name: Fish Chowder
description: Hot and salty. Restores 40 HP; a warm belly halves the harm bad air does for a while.

name: Garlic Broth
description: Clears the head. Restores 10 HP and clears 25 points of bad-air exposure from the lungs.

name: Grog Tot
description: A measured tot from the galley jugs (not the Frog Grog itself). Restores 10 HP; less bad air reaches the lungs for 90s, but the hands wobble.
